record.title: Radxa ZERO 3W — RK3566 quad-A55 SBC, 40-pin header, 22-pin MIPI CSI, USB-C ×2, Wi-Fi 6 / BT 5.4 (the Microduck's compute board)
record.why: electrical identity and the header/bus map are vendor-cited in iterations/v0.0.1/electrical.host.json (that record's own verdict is PASS); the mechanical side is two disagreeing drill patterns (cad/part.py — Pollen's Pi-Zero mesh vs Radxa's brief) with no interface frame declared in cad/interfaces.json, and the SKU Pollen fits is unknown, so the folder cannot grade itself better than CANNOT DETERMINE. What settles it: a production unit (SKU label, drill measured) and an interfaces.json frame.
record.origin_why: electrical facts read off Radxa's own product brief (RAD-DOC-0084 rev 1.10), schematics v1.11 and v1.12, and two radxa.com pages, all fetched 2026-09-02 (iterations/v0.0.1/PROVENANCE.json); lifecycle 'active' on the brief's own sentence 'availability … until a minimum date of September 2030' (§8 p.8)
